messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: spaghetti plot
parts:
For starters, see the examples on pp. 50-52 of the ggplot2 book. Here
is some code to generate a couple of the examples:

data(Oxboys, package="nlme")
qplot(age, height, data=Oxboys, group = Subject, geom="line")

# Why you need the group aesthetic:
qplot(age, height, data=Oxboys, geom="line")

## ggplot() version
p <- ggplot(Oxboys, aes(x = age, y = height, group = Subject)) +
geom_line()
p

# To add the average line to the plot:
p + geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", color = "darkorange", se = FALSE)

# To get a loess average, remove 'method = "lm" from the above call
p + geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), color = "darkorange", se = FALSE)

Dennis
